title: Discovery Judgment Check
description: A fictional sales-enablement knowledge check using engine-native assessment content.
instruction: Choose the best response for each question. Feedback appears after you answer.

questions.prompt: A customer says their current network works most of the time, but outages stop a critical workflow. What should the seller explore first?

options.text: The operational impact and frequency of the outages
options.feedback: Correct. Start by understanding the business and operational impact before jumping to a solution.

options.text: Which product model they want to purchase
options.feedback: That moves to product selection before the underlying need is understood.

options.text: Whether they have seen the latest product presentation
options.feedback: A presentation may help later, but it does not clarify the customer's problem.

questions.prompt: Which question is most likely to reveal a meaningful mobility requirement?

options.text: How do workers and connected devices move through the environment during a normal shift?
options.feedback: Correct. This connects mobility to the actual workflow and environment.

options.text: How many slides should be in the proposal?
options.feedback: That is unrelated to the customer's mobility requirement.

options.text: Would you like us to send a brochure?
options.feedback: That may be a follow-up action, but it does not uncover the requirement.
